fact: Digital Policy Alert describes Ghana's 2008 Electronic Transactions Act as an existing law that sets fair business practice requirements for suppliers, consumer rights and liability protections for intermediaries.

Digital Policy Alert reports that in November 2023 Ghana's Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation issued an enforcement notice under the Electronic Transactions Act requiring all e-commerce platforms and digital delivery companies to register by January 2024.
The US Country Commercial Guide, published 2024-09-20, says the 2008 Electronic Transactions Act is Ghana's e-commerce and e-signature baseline.
